preconditions.description: The input is a single integer x representing the required sharpness, where 1 ≤ x ≤ 100.

postconditions.expression: int(stdout.strip()) >= 1 and all(int(stdout.strip()) >= n_min for n_min in range(1, 101) if any(all(Ai[j] == Aj[i] == An_i[j] == An_j[i] for i in range(1, n+1) for j in range(1, n+1) for Ai in [A] for Aj in [A] for An_i in [A] for An_j in [A] for A in [matrix] if sum(sum(row) for row in matrix) == x and all(Ai[j] + Ai[j+1] + Ai+1[j] + Ai+1[j+1] <= 1 for i in range(1, n) for j in range(1, n) for Ai in [matrix[i-1]] for Ai_plus_1 in [matrix[i]] if Ai_plus_1[j-1] + Ai_plus_1[j] <= 1 and Ai_plus_1[j-1] + Ai_plus_1[j] <= 1)])
postconditions.description: The output is the smallest positive integer n such that there exists a clear (no two adjacent 1s) and symmetrical (horizontally and vertically) n×n binary matrix with exactly x ones (sharpness).

postconditions.expression: int(stdout.strip()) == min(n for n in range(1, 101) if any(all(Ai[j] == Aj[i] == An_i[j] == An_j[i] for i in range(1, n+1) for j in range(1, n+1) for Ai in [A] for Aj in [A] for An_i in [A] for An_j in [A] for A in [matrix] if sum(sum(row) for row in matrix) == x and all(Ai[j] + Ai[j+1] + Ai+1[j] + Ai+1[j+1] <= 1 for i in range(1, n) for j in range(1, n) for Ai in [matrix[i-1]] for Ai_plus_1 in [matrix[i]] if Ai_plus_1[j-1] + Ai_plus_1[j] <= 1 and Ai_plus_1[j-1] + Ai_plus_1[j] <= 1)))
postconditions.description: The output is the minimal n for which such a matrix exists, ensuring no smaller n satisfies the conditions.
